scope: Bounded source-use and pre-discovery exposure review for two original workbooks shared by the selected cross-document, BPI and Taking Part drafts; not a Gold freeze or a claim of exhaustive independence

publisherSources.observed: Each official release lists its XLSX original. The release pages state OGL v3.0 except where otherwise stated; GOV.UK terms allow reuse of covered content subject to the licence. The licence requires source attribution and excludes certain logos, personal data and unlicensed third-party rights. The same-release BPI PDF has its own OGL notice on page 4, as checked in the prior BPI receipt.

originalWorkbookParts.imageMeaning: Department emblem and name on Contents sheet, previously reviewed as decorative in the isolated product clone

boundedPreDiscoveryExposure.falsePositiveBoundary: Generic percentages 75.6% and 33.1% and numeral 77,617 have unrelated historical uses; absence of those numerals is not asserted.

boundedUseDecision.allowedCandidateUse: Private evaluation questions and short numerical answers attributed to the two official releases, with exact workbook cells and source links; the department emblem is excluded from answer content.

remaining: In the final freeze, handle all three questions as two shared source families and check source-level leakage after any development change.
Verify user-visible attribution and exact two-workbook citations under G15/G16 controls before claiming answer quality.
Unrecorded prompts, binary contents outside the inspected originals, provider-side exposure and model pretraining are not covered by this bounded local audit.
